description: The Backup Service REST API's own reference pages spell the same RBAC role three different ways, and one page adds a fourth register on top. roles.md's own catalogue names it 'Backup Full Admin (backup_admin)'. backup-get-expired-backups.md, backup-get-plan-info.md, backup-get-repository-info.md and backup-get-task-info.md all use the full display label 'Backup Full Admin'. backup-get-cluster-info.md instead reads 'Full Admin, Backup Admin, or Read-Only Admin role' - dropping 'Full'. backup-manage-config.md compounds this with a second, unrelated typo in the same sentence ('Full Amin, Backup Admin, or Read-Only Admin'). Separately, backup-node-threads.md's 403 Forbidden error example names the SAME permission via its bare internal string `ro_admin`, a third naming register (neither the display label 'Read-Only Admin' nor a spelled-out internal name) that a reader has to already know maps to Read-Only Admin. Three of four pages agree with each other and one does not, and no page cross-references any other's spelling.
